abstract: Dysgerminoma of the ovary is composed of cells that resemble primordial germ cells morphologically and connective tissue stroma with lymphoid cell infiltration, the degree of which has been discussed in correlation with the prognosis. In order to characterize the lymphoid cells histochemically, a sensitive immunoperoxidase technique was applied on serial tumor tissue sections. Monoclonal antibodies used in this study were anti-HLA-ABC, anti-HLA-DR, anti-HLe-1 (leukocytes), anti-Leu-1,-4(pan T cells), anti-Leu-2a (killer/suppressor T cells), anti-Leu-3a (helper/inducer T cells), anti-Leu-12,-14 (B cells), anti-Leu-M3 (monocytes/macrophages) and OKT-10 (myeloid and lymphoid precursors, thymocytes, activated T and B cells). Lymphoid cells identified morphologically on sections stained with hematoxylin-eosin were HLe-1 positive, and were therefore thought to originate in bone marrow. Most of them were also positive for Leu-1,-4, and they were composed of nearly equal numbers of Leu-2a positive cells and Leu-3a positive cells. Furthermore, the majority of the lymphoid cells were HLA-DR positive, consisting of a large number of OKT-10 positive cells and a small number of Leu-12,-14 positive cells and Leu-M3 positive cells which were mainly found in connective stroma encapsulating tumor tissue. Taken together, the lymphoid cells in the connective stroma were considered to be activated T cells. Tumor cells themselves lacked reactivity with anti-HLA-ABC or anti-HLA-DR, while lymphoid cells and connective stroma were HLA-ABC positive.
abstract_ja: 卵巣のディスジャーミノーマは、原始胚細胞に形態学的に類似する細胞と、リンパ球浸潤を伴う結合組織間質から構成され、その浸潤の程度は予後との関連で論じられてきた。リンパ球を組織化学的に特徴づけるため、連続腫瘍組織切片に感度の高い免疫ペルオキシダーゼ法を適用した。用いたモノクローナル抗体は、抗HLA-ABC、抗HLA-DR、抗HLe-1（白血球）、抗Leu-1,-4（全T細胞）、抗Leu-2a（キラー/サプレッサーT細胞）、抗Leu-3a（ヘルパー/誘導T細胞）、抗Leu-12,-14（B細胞）、抗Leu-M3（単球/マクロファージ）、OKT-10（骨髄系およびリンパ系前駆細胞、胸腺細胞、活性化T細胞およびB細胞）である。HE染色切片で形態的に同定されたリンパ球はHLe-1陽性であり、骨髄由来と考えられた。その大半はLeu-1,-4にも陽性で、Leu-2a陽性細胞とLeu-3a陽性細胞がほぼ同数を占めた。さらにリンパ球の大多数はHLA-DR陽性であり、OKT-10陽性細胞が多数を占め、Leu-12,-14陽性細胞とLeu-M3陽性細胞は少数で、主に腫瘍組織を囲む結合組織間質に認められた。以上より、結合組織内のリンパ球は活性化T細胞と考えられた。腫瘍細胞自体はHLA-ABCまたはHLA-DRに対する反応性を欠いていたが、リンパ球と結合組織間質はHLA-ABC陽性であった。
